card.name: US census demographic text
card.fires_on: Spaces, digits and small words inside US census passages, such as town demographics and census campaign news. It fires just before a number like 100, 1, or a year.

modes.label: Gender ratio sentences
modes.description: The space after "For every" in census sex-ratio lines, just before 100 females.

modes.label: Census dates and years
modes.description: Spaces or digits inside dates and years in census news, such as April 1 or July 1, 2003.

modes.label: Census wording
modes.description: Small words in census phrasing, such as "the" in "as of the census of 2000" or "of" before age groups.

card.writes: It likely prepares numbers like 100 or years, which has no clear link to the promoted or suppressed tokens.
card.plain: It lights up in census-style text just before a number such as 100 or a date is expected.
